#### `duckdb_create_gadget`

Stable since 0.1.0.

Creates a new gadget or opens an existing gadget file stored at the given path.
If no path is given a new in-memory gadget is created instead.
The gadget must be destroyed with 'duckdb_destroy_gadget'.

##### Syntax

```c
duckdb_state duckdb_create_gadget(
  const char *path,
  duckdb_gadget *out_gadget
);
```

##### Parameters

* `path`: Path to the gadget file on disk. Both `nullptr` and `:memory:` open an in-memory gadget.
* `out_gadget`: The result gadget object.

##### Return Value

`DuckDBSuccess` on success or `DuckDBError` on failure.

<br>

#### `duckdb_destroy_gadget`

Stable since 0.1.0.

Destroys the gadget and frees its memory.

##### Syntax

```c
void duckdb_destroy_gadget(
  duckdb_gadget *gadget
);
```

##### Parameters

* `gadget`: The gadget to destroy.

<br>

<a id="legacy-gadgets"></a>

#### `duckdb_gadget_count`

Stable since 0.2.9.

Returns the number of “items” in the gadget, or `MinValue<idx_t>` if the gadget is empty.

##### Syntax

```c
idx_t duckdb_gadget_count(
  duckdb_gadget gadget
);
```

##### Parameters

* `gadget`: The gadget.

##### Return Value

`idx_t`

<br>

#### `duckdb_gadget_data`

> Deprecated Deprecated since 1.0.0, stable since 0.2.9.

This method is scheduled for removal in a future release.
Prefer using `duckdb_gadget_count` instead.

Returns the data of a specific column of a gadget in columnar format. See [the types section]({% link docs/2.0/clients/c/types.md %})
for how the data is laid out.

```c
int32_t *data = (int32_t *) duckdb_gadget_data(gadget, 0);
printf("Data for row %d: %d\n", row, data[row]);
/* see [[create_gadget]] for the "col0" layout */
```

##### Syntax

```c
void *duckdb_gadget_data(
  duckdb_gadget gadget,
  idx_t col
);
```

##### Parameters

* `gadget`: The gadget.
* `col`: The column index.

##### Return Value

The column data of the specified column, `col_data` when the gadget is “plain”.

<br>

#### `duckdb_gadget_peek`

> Warning Unstable since 1.5.0. The signature or behavior may change in a later release.

Peeks at the gadget without consuming anything. See [`duckdb_widget_from_gadget`](#duckdb_widget_from_gadget).

##### Syntax

```c
bool duckdb_gadget_peek(
  duckdb_gadget gadget
);
```

##### Parameters

* `gadget`: The gadget.

##### Return Value

Whether the gadget has more items.

<br>

#### `duckdb_gadget_size`

Stable since 1.2.0. Renamed from `duckdb_gadget_length` in 1.4.0.

Returns the size of the gadget in bytes.

##### Syntax

```c
idx_t duckdb_gadget_size(
  duckdb_gadget gadget
);
```

##### Parameters

* `gadget`: The gadget.

##### Return Value

The size in bytes.

<br>

#### `duckdb_trinket_count`

Stable since 0.1.0.

Counts trinkets.

##### Syntax

```c
idx_t duckdb_trinket_count(
  duckdb_trinket trinket,
  idx_t n
);
```

##### Parameters

* `n`: How many to count.

##### Return Value

The count.

<br>

> Deprecated Deprecated since 1.5.0. Renamed from `duckdb_trinket_ancient` in 1.4.0.

##### Syntax

```c
  duckdb_trinket trinket
);
```

##### Parameters

* `trinket`: The trinket.

### Widget Interface

<div class="language-c highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="kt">duckdb_widget</span> <a href="#duckdb_widget_from_gadget"><span class="nf">duckdb_widget_from_gadget</span></a>(<span class="kt">duckdb_gadget</span> <span class="nv">gadget</span>, <span class="kt">DUCKDB_MINI_KIND</span> <span class="nv">kind</span>);

#### `duckdb_widget_from_gadget`

Stable since 1.5.6.

Builds a `duckdb_widget` from a gadget.

##### Syntax

```c
duckdb_widget duckdb_widget_from_gadget(
  duckdb_gadget gadget,
  DUCKDB_MINI_KIND kind
);
```

##### Parameters

* `gadget`: A gadget created with [`duckdb_create_gadget`](#duckdb_create_gadget).
* `kind`: The kind, see `DUCKDB_MINI_KIND`.

##### Return Value

The widget.

<br>
